decisions.reason: The requested background change for four special pages does not alter photo selection, integration, or image-frame treatment.
Replacing the light pink/cream wash with another treatment or white does not revoke or change the requirement to apply Agua Arc identity, logo, and colors.
The special-page background feedback does not change the supplied tables or their integration into the proposal.
The visual background revision does not change the required PDF format, file count, email submission, or export properties.
The requested design revision does not change Canva access, ownership, editability, asset policy, or reuse rights.
The source refers to the document cover and other special pages, not the separate first-page cover letter or its one-page limit.
Changing special-page backgrounds does not alter narrative content integration, fixed section order, or the unresolved inclusion of Section 6.
The background treatment decision has no necessary effect on hyperlink functionality in the saved proposal.
The message supplies one revision comment but does not change the number of revision rounds or the condition for beginning final revisions.
The source concerns the separate GreenLatinos RFQ document and does not affect the TPEC proposal design requirement.
Changing a page background does not necessarily alter page count, spacing, content reduction, or page-limit compliance.
The design feedback does not change any draft, revision, submission, or content-finalization deadline.
